style: Bright, chunky jigsaw pieces on white with hard ink outlines: a role piece and a person piece that snap together, for founders making their first hires.

concept.idea: Hiring is finding the piece that fits: every part of the site is a jigsaw piece whose tab locks into the next one's blank.
concept.signature: In the hero, a pink role piece and a mint person piece swing in from either side and interlock with a little overshoot, then the pair wobbles at rest and the person piece lifts out and re-seats itself now and then. Services form a chain where each piece clicks down into the next on hover; the six roles are one puzzle that snaps together on scroll.
concept.motionVerb: snap into place: a little overshoot, then lock

jury.note: Round 2 self-score after fixes, from the /jury rubric and fresh shoot/audit evidence (0 serious axe, 0 audit FAIL, no overflow). Round 1 was a blind critic; its scores are in blindRound1.
